innervation.root_levels: C1 (fibers travel with CN XII but originate from the C1 ventral ramus)

actions: depresses the mandible when the hyoid is fixed

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Lies superior to mylohyoid, deep to genioglossus; its 'hypoglossal' innervation is a well-known misnomer -- the fibers are true C1 ventral ramus fibers that simply hitchhike within the hypoglossal nerve's sheath rather than being true CN XII motor fibers.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
